Challenges

Sound familiar?

“Bloggers never reply to our pitches.”

Templated blasts get deleted. Our pitches are written per blogger — referencing their content and audience — so reply rates look nothing like mass outreach.

“We got placed on blogs that turned out to be link farms.”

Every prospect is vetted for real traffic, audience authenticity and editorial quality before outreach begins.

“Bloggers keep asking for payment.”

Paid placements are a different market with different risks. We earn coverage through relevance, reviews and stories — and disclose honestly when a blogger’s policy differs.

“Our product reviews read like ads.”

Review campaigns are coordinated, not scripted: bloggers get access and facts, then write in their own voice — which is why readers trust them.

“We can’t tell which placements are live.”

A live placement tracker shows every feature as it publishes, with the URL, target page and anchor.

“Outreach takes forever to show results.”

Relationships compound: a blogger who features you once answers faster next time. The program builds an asset, not a one-off blast.

“Our niche feels too small for blogger coverage.”

Niche blogs with loyal audiences often outperform big generic sites for both traffic and rankings — mapping finds them.

“Previous outreach damaged our brand’s reputation.”

Spammy outreach does that. Personalised, relevant pitches protect the brand — bloggers regularly thank our team for doing it properly.

How It Works

Relationships beat blasts, every time

Bloggers delete a hundred templated pitches a week. They answer the ones that show the sender actually read their blog, understands their audience and offers something worth covering.

Our outreach team builds and maintains relationships across hundreds of niches — researching each blog, pitching relevant angles, and supplying content and products that make coverage easy to say yes to.

  • Vetted blogger prospect list
  • Outreach pitch set
  • Review campaign coordination
  • Guest content where agreed
  • Live placement tracker
  • Monthly coverage report

FAQs

FAQs on blogger outreach services

How is this different from buying blog links?

We earn coverage through relevance and relationships — bloggers choose to feature you, and placements are disclosed properly.

Which niches do you cover?

Health, tech, finance, travel, lifestyle, e-commerce and more — prospect research confirms fit before outreach starts.

Do bloggers get paid?

Some review campaigns involve product samples or fees for the blogger's time; anything paid is disclosed and handled transparently.

How soon will coverage appear?

First placements typically land within the first 4–6 weeks as relationships warm up.

How many placements should we expect?

It depends on the niche and the offer bloggers are responding to — your proposal sets a realistic range from the prospect map, and the live tracker shows progress against it.
